artworks.title: The Service Flag
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a two-story house viewed from a slightly lower left angle. The drawing style is loose and dynamic, using quick strokes to suggest texture and shading. The color palette is minimalist, with black lines on a light beige or cream-toned paper. The sketch includes surrounding foliage and a simplified figure to the left.

artworks.title: On the Ways
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: A drawing of a ship under construction or repair in a boatyard. The scene shows a large ship propped up by scaffolding. The structural lines of the ship and its supporting framework are rough and expressive. The shading highlights the ship's form and the texture of the surrounding area, creating a lively atmosphere. The monochrome and dynamic sketch lines convey a sense of immediacy and progress in the boatyard setting.

artworks.title: Deshabille
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image displays a seated person in a large, cushioned armchair. The person reclines comfortably with their head against the chair's backrest. They have long, dark hair, soft facial features, and wear a loose, robe-like garment. Their legs are crossed with dark stockings or boots. The person's hands hold a piece of paper or a small book. The armchair has a patterned fabric design and scattered papers around it. The background features vertical lines hinting at a wall or curtain. The overall ambiance is calm and informal.

artworks.title: The Spar Shop, Gloucester
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a workshop interior with logs and timber. The scene shows wooden beams and logs scattered across the floor, with visible wooden rafters and large windows on the left side. A ladder leans against the right wall near a large open door. Through the door, a landscape with buildings and hills is seen. The drawing uses lines and shading to convey the texture of wood and the rustic atmosphere of the workshop.

artworks.title: Stone Fences, Land of Nod
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a horizon in the upper third. Distant trees and small houses can be seen. The drawing uses loose pencil strokes with rough outlines. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray on a cream background. Jagged lines suggest shrubbery or abstract tree forms in the foreground. Smooth slopes and fields extend into the distance. Fluffy clouds float above the scene.

artworks.title: Camouflage
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a monochromatic sketch of a riverside scene. The sketch depicts a view across a body of water towards a distant shore. A row of structures is visible along the horizon, resting on a cliff or elevated bank. The sketch features quick, linear brushstrokes in black against a light tan background, creating an impressionistic style. Reflective marks on the water's surface suggest ripples. Some figures are visible, near docks or wooden platforms. The image relies on contrast to convey a serene riverside environment.

artworks.title: Violet Girl
artworks.medium: lithograph in black with tan stone tint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl seated on a chair with her upper body visible. She is in a side-facing seated position with her hands resting on a table. She has a youthful face with a contemplative expression, a headscarf covering most of her hair, and is wearing a dark cloak with large sleeves. The table has a textured surface with a few objects placed on it. The background consists of a plain wall with a decorative element to the right.

artworks.title: Woodrow Wilson
artworks.artist: Timothy Cole, after John Singer Sargent
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. James Parmelee, 1935)
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper three-quarters of a man's body. He is seated in an armchair, facing slightly to his left with his body angled towards the viewer. The man features short hair that is parted to the side and has a clean-shaven face, with a serious expression. He is dressed in a formal suit consisting of a dark jacket, a vest, and a tie over a white shirt. His right hand rests on the arm of the chair while his left hand is placed on his lap. In the background, there is a dark, plain backdrop highlighting the subject. A round table is partially visible beside him. The artist's signature, "Timothy Cole," is at the bottom of the portrait.

artworks.title: The U.S. Frigate United States Capturing His Britannic Majesty's Frigate Macedonian
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1963)
artworks.description: The image shows a maritime scene with two ships in a naval battle. The horizon is low, depicting the sea and sky. The ships, waves, rigging, and sails are detailed, with a color palette of blues, aquamarine, browns, creams, whites, grays, reds, and blues. Smoke from the ships' guns indicates firing.

artworks.title: J. M. Carlisle
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a portrait, shown in profile facing to the left. He has a strong jawline, curly sideburns, wavy medium-length hair, and is wearing a dark suit jacket over a waistcoat, a white shirt with a bow tie. The background is plain. Below the portrait is a signature and the text "BRANT & FULLER, PUBS."

artworks.title: Mission Santa Barbara
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image is a landscape print depicting a view from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is positioned towards the upper third of the image, where mountains meet the sky. Architectural structures with arches and bell towers are set against the mountains. The technique used involves fine brushstrokes or etching, providing detail to both buildings and the landscape. The color palette is monochromatic, using varying shades of brown and sepia. A pathway leads into the scene, bordered by rocks and sparse vegetation. Beyond, the landscape opens into cultivated land and scattered trees, guiding the view towards the structures and mountains in the distance.

artworks.title: Mission San Gabriel Arcángel
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a historic mission building. The horizon is in the background, with the mission aligned along it. The architecture features arches and a bell. A tall palm tree is to the right of the building. The sky has wispy clouds with fine brushstrokes. The color palette is primarily sepia. Foliage and shrubs are in the foreground. Faint outlines of mountain ranges can be seen in the distance.

artworks.title: Fishing
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a natural setting by the riverside. Two figures are depicted near a body of water. One figure is sitting on a wooden structure holding a fishing rod over the water, while the other figure stands nearby on the ground. The scene is under a large tree with intricate branches and leaves. In the background, the water reflects the greenery. The artist used detailed line work and cross-hatching to bring texture to the elements in the drawing.

artworks.title: View Near Rome
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a landscape with two trees in the foreground, rocky terrain, bushes, a village, and a church or tower in the middle distance. Beyond them are rugged mountains on the horizon. The image has a detailed etching style with a monochromatic color palette of grey and black.

artworks.title: A View Near Rome
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from an elevated viewpoint, displaying rugged terrain, mountains in the distance, a settlement with small structures and a tower, detailed textures of rocks, foliage, and structures. The black and white color palette emphasizes a timeless quality. The scene includes uneven ground with rocks and vegetation, leading towards the center where a few figures are visible, with trees on the right side.

artworks.title: Reward of Merit
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of children playing and walking in an outdoor setting next to a village. The scene captures a group of children engaged in various activities outside. On the left side, some children are sitting and walking, while in the center and right side, others are playing a game that seems to involve a ball. The background features a village with distinct buildings, including one with a steeple and a clock tower. Trees frame the scene, with a canopy of leaves on the upper left and a line of tall, conical trees along a pathway on the right. The ground appears textured and lined, adding depth to the landscape.

artworks.title: On New York Bay
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image shows a view from the shores of a body of water, possibly a harbor or estuary, looking toward moored boats on the right. The boats have their masts and rigging reaching upward. The horizon is low in the image, with distant landforms and hints of ships on the waterline. The lines suggest shadows and textures with a sketch-like quality. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily sepia and grey tones. The detail gives a sense of calm along the water's edge. In the distance are more ships, with their masts rising against a sky streaked with thin clouds.

artworks.title: December
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene with a forest path. The horizon is depicted where the trees meet the sky. The detailed engravings show leafless, twisting branches. The ground is textured with linework to show earth and vegetation. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and sepia. In the distance, a path winds through the trees with two small figures present.

artworks.title: California Landscape
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a tree in the foreground, a field with scattered trees and shrubs, grazing animals, hills in the background, and a light sky. The tree has intricate branches and the ground is textured. The color scheme is mainly ochre and sepia.

artworks.title: Mission San Luis Rey de Francia
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image shows a large, old Spanish-style mission building in the center. The horizon is positioned near the lower third, with the sky dominating the upper portion. In the distance, mountains serve as a natural boundary. The architectural structure has fine brushwork with precise lines to give it texture and definition. Close to us, there are patches of grass and shrubs. Two small figures walk on a path towards the mission. The coloring consists of subtle shades of tan and gray, creating a vintage, sepia-toned effect.

artworks.title: Mission San Carlos Borromeo
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image displays an old stone building with a dome, likely a mission, seen from a slightly elevated position. The horizon line is above the central building, aligned just below distant hills and trees. The etching technique shows detailed lines and cross-hatching, giving the scene texture and depth. The color palette is sepia, creating an aged appearance. There are grazing animals and ruins nearby. The building stands in the middle, surrounded by extending ruins. In the background, there are hills and vegetation with delicate details. The sky is filled with light clouds drawn with fine strokes.

artworks.title: Near Mattakeesett
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image shows a beach scene with a pair of oxen pulling a cart on the rocky shore. A figure guides the animals. The terrain is uneven with rocks and patches of grass. A hillside covered in foliage is on the left, captured with detailed etchings. The sky has light clouds, and small distant sailboats are on the horizon. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown.

artworks.title: The Path to the Shore
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a path. There is sloping terrain on the left with grass and a windswept tree, while the path curves to the right with rocks and sparse vegetation. In the distance, a person walks towards a body of water with trees and a reflection. The horizon is low with a sky containing subtle cloud forms. The scene is detailed with cross-hatching brushstrokes, creating intricate textures. The color palette is monochrome in shades of gray and black, giving the image a soft, atmospheric quality.

artworks.title: The Angelus
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1927)
artworks.description: The image shows a view from slightly above ground level of two figures standing in an open field. The horizon is towards the upper third of the image, with the field stretching towards distant trees and structures under a cloudy sky. A man with a hat stands next to a woman who is bowing her head with hands clasped, near a scattered array of dug-up turnips and a resting wheelbarrow. The art style appears to use fine strokes resembling hand-drawn etching, with intricate details in the clothing and features of the individuals. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of sepia or brown to create an earthy and subdued atmosphere in the rural setting.
